root_cause.text: In `idpf_idc_vport_dev_down()`, the code dereferences `vport->vdev_info` for every vport without first checking if it was allocated, causing a NULL pointer dereference when RDMA is not supported on that vport.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `|| !vport->vdev_info` to the existing NULL check, preventing the dereference of `vdev_info` that is only allocated when `VIRTCHNL2_VPORT_ENABLE_RDMA` flag is set (as stated in the CVE description).

bic_trace_step.reason: In idpf_idc_vport_dev_down() (lines 249-262 of the added code), the loop accesses `vport->vdev_info->adev` without checking if `vport->vdev_info` is NULL.
